# DEAD FREQUENCY — Campaign Time Budget

**This is a model, not a measurement.** It is generated by `tools/time_budget.py` from the shipped chapter data: dialogue and camera time, document words, walkable floor area, puzzle gates and authored Listener encounters, converted to minutes with the explicit rates below. No human has played the full campaign yet; the first playtest round (13_TESTING_PLAN.md) replaces these rates with measured ones. **Do not quote the 10–15 h target as achieved until playtests show it.**

Rates: exploration 0.55–1.30 s per m² of floor · puzzle 75–210 s each · authored encounter 45–150 s each · reading 200 wpm · +15% retries on the high estimate. Optional areas are assigned 30% of their floor area.

New Game+ adds the 88.0 thread, changed encounters and a smarter Listener; it is replay content and is not counted above.

## How to replace the model with data
1. Playtest build logs chapter start/end times (planned: a debug overlay writes `playtime.csv`).
2. Five first-time players per round; record main-path time, optional time, deaths.
3. Update `RATE` in `tools/time_budget.py` so the model reproduces the measured median, then use it to plan further content.
